description: This file defines the CachedNamespaceInvalidator class, an Akka actor responsible for invalidating cache entries related to blocked namespaces in a distributed system. It includes logic for subscribing to namespace changes, delayed invalidation, and cache management.

classes.name: CachedNamespaceInvalidator
classes.description: An Akka actor that listens for namespace change events and invalidates cache entries for blocked namespaces after a delay.

classes.name: InvalidateCachedNamespaces
classes.description: A private static class encapsulating a set of namespaces to invalidate within the CachedNamespaceInvalidator actor.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates and configures Props for instantiating the CachedNamespaceInvalidator actor with specific blocked namespaces and caches.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines the message handling logic for the actor, including reacting to namespace change notifications and invalidation triggers.

methods.name: handleChanged
methods.description: Processes Replicator.Changed messages to detect namespace updates and triggers invalidation.

methods.name: logNamespaces
methods.description: Logs the list of namespaces received or being invalidated, with a different format depending on the size.

methods.name: invalidateNamespacesAfterDelay
methods.description: Schedules delayed invalidation of caches for specific namespaces.

methods.name: invalidateCachedNamespaces
methods.description: Invalidates cache entries associated with given namespaces.

methods.name: invalidateNamespaces
methods.description: Invalidates cache entries for entity IDs whose namespace matches the blocked namespaces.

methods.name: containsNamespaceOfEntityId
methods.description: Checks if the namespace of an entity ID is in the blocked namespaces set.
